how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zul-gurub-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8041:completion:0: Hail, ⟦1⟧. I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will.
rows.quest:8041:completion:1: BWear this talisman around your neck, ⟦2⟧. Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!
rows.quest:8043:completion:0: Use your newfound strength to destroy the Gurubashi!
rows.quest:8044:completion:0: Zul'jin would be envious, ⟦4⟧. Go forth and conquer!
rows.quest:8045:completion:0: Know this, heathen: A catastrophe has brought us together. Your pagan ways are neither understood nor appreciated by Zandalar but we are a fair people. Wear this brand around your neck. It shall serve as both a warning to our enemies and a symbol of your friendship to Zandalar.
rows.quest:8045:completion:1: BContinue to serve our people and I will amplify the power of the brand.
rows.quest:8046:completion:0: Do what you must to defeat our enemies, ⟦5⟧. Even if it means channeling the Light.
rows.quest:8047:completion:0: Our beliefs differ but our cause is righteous. Strike down our foes, noble ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:8048:completion:0: Vigilance, honor, loyalty, bravery... You embody all of these traits and so shall your brand.
rows.quest:8049:completion:0: Accept this talisman as a token of our appreciation, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:8049:completion:1: BThe Eye of Zuldazar will grow in power as your bond with the trolls of Zandalar strengthens. Return to me periodically and I shall imbue the jewel.
rows.quest:8050:completion:0: Be resolute in your endeavors, ⟦9⟧. The Soulflayer will attempt to siphon your will to live.
rows.quest:8051:completion:0: Continue in your battle against the Soulflayer and his minions, ⟦10⟧. He must never be permitted to leave the confines of Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:8052:completion:0: ⟦E1⟧ them all and let Hakkar sort them out...
rows.quest:8053:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8053:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8053:details:0: You are a heathen. Heathens have a place in the tribe. Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar. Freethinkers do not fear oppression. Freethinkers die for what they believe in. We know you would die for what you believe in. This earns our acknowledgement. This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.
rows.quest:8053:details:1: BWe must have the Paragons of Power. Go to Zul'Gurub. Kill the minions of Hakkar. Return when you have what I seek. Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.
rows.quest:8053:completion:0: You do much to honor us. Your hands drip with the blood of Hakkar's minions. You are a friend to the tribe.
rows.quest:8053:completion:1: BWear these bracers. They are the freethinker's armguards. This is what I mean about real power.
rows.quest:8054:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8054:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8054:details:0: Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen. Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics. This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong. Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar. Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin. Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God. We honor the price they paid. They are the freethinkers.
rows.quest:8054:details:1: BDestroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub. Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek. Success will be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:8054:completion:0: Your honor is assured in the tribe. You claim many deaths in Zul'Gurub. Enemies fall before your convictions. Enemies fall before your power.
rows.quest:8054:completion:1: BThis is the freethinker's belt. It is a symbol of honor. It is powerful mojo. It is now yours.
rows.quest:8055:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8055:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8055:details:0: Battle gear gives you power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots. They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.
rows.quest:8055:details:1: BYou must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate. Go to Zul'Gurub. Take the Paragons of Power I need. Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside. Bring them to me. Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.
rows.quest:8055:completion:0: You have done what few ever could. You have brought the minions of Hakkar to their knees. You have shown them what a freethinker can do. You have shown us how a heretic could be revered in the tribe. You have more than real power. You ARE real power.
rows.quest:8055:completion:1: BTake the breastplate, freethinker. Crush those who oppose you.
rows.quest:8056:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8056:obj:1: BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8056:details:0: The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon. They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people. As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe.
rows.quest:8056:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!
rows.quest:8056:completion:0: It seems ya got a bit of the Zandalar augur in ya. We know about the deeds you've been doin' in Zul'Gurub on our behalf mon. These Paragons of Power will go a long way to helpin' out the Zandalar tribe - a tribe, I might add, ya can call upon as friends. Take these bracers, ⟦11⟧; ya earned them and then some!
rows.quest:8057:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Stanchion. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8057:obj:1: BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8057:details:0: A haruspex is a key member of our tribe; you'll be wise to listen to their portents. By communion with animals and givin' them up to the spirits when needed, they give us divine guidance. In times past, the haruspex's insight and wisdom gave us an edge in the wars against the splintered tribes of the Gurubashi.
rows.quest:8057:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this, and I'll give ya bracers that any haruspex of the Zandalar would want.
rows.quest:8057:completion:0: Ah, I can sense the power comin' from these Paragons of Power, ⟦12⟧. Ya proved to be someone we in the tribe can call "friend." A deal is a deal, ⟦13⟧... behold the power of the haruspex's bracers!
rows.quest:8058:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8058:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8058:details:0: ⟦E3⟧ is power. The Zandalar vindicator is such power. The tribe has many enemies. The vindicator exacts retribution on them. No crime against us is unpunished. The vindicator delivers this punishment. Our enemies fear our vengeance. They should. They forever will.
rows.quest:8058:details:1: BBecome one of our vindicators. Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub. Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name. You will be rewarded.
rows.quest:8058:completion:0: You have wrought much vengeance today. You have taken on the visage of the vindicator. You have brought the Blood God's minions to their knees.
rows.quest:8058:completion:1: BTake this. It will fuel your vengeance for the future. You are a friend to the Zandalar now.
rows.quest:8059:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8059:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8059:details:0: Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further. Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a demon to enter their being. Rather than let it possess them though, they enslave the demon from the inside, absorbing the power of the beast for their own command. It is a feat few are ever able to master.
rows.quest:8059:details:1: BFor you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub. Go there and retrieve that which we seek.
rows.quest:8059:completion:0: Well done... no doubt they were made to pay in excruciating ways before they gave up the Paragons of Power. Take this - the demoniac's wraps. Made from powerful mojo used in summoning the demoniac's prey, it is a powerful tool in your acquisition of power.
rows.quest:8060:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8060:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8060:details:0: Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!
rows.quest:8060:details:2: BIt is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!
rows.quest:8060:details:3: BFor you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.
rows.quest:8060:completion:0: Impressive... could you feel the mojo flowing through them? The Paragons of Power were used as currency of sorts back when the Gurubashi Empire ruled these lands. Now we Zandalar will use the latent mojo inside of them to fight the second rise of the Blood God Hakkar!
rows.quest:8060:completion:1: BYou've done well today - consider yourself to have a friend in the Zandalar. For that, here are the illusionist's wraps I promised!
rows.quest:8061:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8061:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8061:details:0: We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity. Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors. Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe. Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.
rows.quest:8061:details:1: BGo to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi. Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.
rows.quest:8061:completion:0: Outstanding, ⟦15⟧! This was no small feat bringing these to me. No doubt you've acted as our tribe's confessor today in preserving ourselves against the threat of Hakkar. These wraps are befitting a friend of the tribe such as you!
rows.quest:8062:obj:0: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8062:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8062:details:0: In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe. Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes. Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.
rows.quest:8062:details:1: BBring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.
rows.quest:8062:completion:0: Yes... I need no vision to sense the presence of the Paragons of Power. Your success in Zul'Gurub has impressed many among the tribe. We not only consider you to be a friend of the Zandalar, but also consider you worthy enough to possess the predator's bracers - powerful items, and a symbol of what it means to be a predator. Well done, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:8063:obj:0: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8063:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8063:details:0: The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence. A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. We would not be here today without them.
rows.quest:8063:details:1: BBring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors. Embrace the madness!
rows.quest:8063:completion:0: Well done, ⟦17⟧... your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend. I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!
rows.quest:8064:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.
rows.quest:8064:details:0: We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature.
rows.quest:8064:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us. Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.
rows.quest:8064:completion:0: I thank you - the latent power in these items will be treasures unto themselves, you betcha. Not only have ya done as I've asked of ya, but you've also proven to be honorable to us here in the tribe. As promised, here is your reward!
rows.quest:8065:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧. You must also be Revered with Zandalar.
rows.quest:8065:details:0: The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear, ⟦18⟧. Of these, the tunic symbolizes the connection between themselves and the divine wisdom they seek. It often weaves parts of the beasties they sacrifice into the tunic; this reminds them of the connection they have to their gifts.
rows.quest:8065:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this, and a tunic seeping with the true power of a haruspex is yours.
rows.quest:8065:completion:0: Impressive... you've successfully collected the required Paragons of Power, ⟦19⟧. Your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub for the Zandalar are legendary; hence forth, you'll be revered amongst the tribe. Here is your tunic, mighty ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:8066:obj:0: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8066:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8066:details:0: A predator knows how to stalk their prey, but a successful one knows how to strike at it once they have closed ranks. You must master both to have any chance of success in Zul'Gurub... and any chance of being like the Zandalar predators.
rows.quest:8066:details:1: BBring me choice parts of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. My reward will be the power that the trinkets yield, while yours will be the Zandalar predator's belt - equipment well worth the trade.
rows.quest:8066:completion:0: I sensed your arrival moments before, ⟦21⟧, but none too easily. What revealed yourself to me were the Paragons of Power you brought. I can feel the power without needing to see the trinkets; their latent mojo - raw magic, if you will - will continue to fuel our efforts of vanquishing the diabolic schemes of the Blood God Hakkar.
rows.quest:8066:completion:1: BYou are to be commended - and rewarded - for your success. You are honored amongst the tribe, and you are worthy to wear the predator's belt.
rows.quest:8067:obj:0: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8067:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8067:details:0: We Zandalar prize what we wear as a symbol of accomplishment. You don't need to be able to see what one wears to be able to sense what emanates from it - power transcends sight. The garments of the Zandalar predator are like this, and most cherished by them is the mantle they wear. It helps to obfuscate them from view... and to make their presence known when they wish it.
rows.quest:8067:details:1: BThe Paragons of Power await your retrieval in Zul'Gurub. Bring me what I seek, and the predator's mantle shall be yours.
rows.quest:8067:completion:0: Success... you are to be revered amongst the tribe, ⟦22⟧. It was no small feat acquiring the Paragons of Power needed for the mantle, but you handled it in the fashion of the deadliest of our predators. You've earned your place amongst them, and you've certainly earned the right to wear their mantle.
rows.quest:8068:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8068:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8068:details:0: Magic is a raw, primal force to be shaped by those strong enough to do it. Mojo is our extension of this power; one such potent manipulation of it is in the form of illusion. How can one truly hope to win against a foe that is not even really there? We Zandalar know the power of this, and as such illusionists hold a honored place within the tribe.
rows.quest:8068:details:1: BTake the needed Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub - for this, honor from the tribe and a powerful mantle used by our best illusionists will be yours!
rows.quest:8068:completion:0: Success! You shall be honored in the tribe from here on! Zul'Gurub has certainly tasted the might of the Zandalar today, thanks to you ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:8068:completion:1: BWith the tribe's blessing, take the Zandalar illusionist's mantle. May it serve you well.
rows.quest:8069:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8069:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8069:details:0: The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear. Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful. Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look. Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.
rows.quest:8069:details:1: BI will give you an illusionist's robe, ⟦24⟧... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first! Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!
rows.quest:8069:completion:0: At last, someone worthy to wear the illusionist's robe! Your success in Zul'Gurub has assured your reverences amongst the tribe for ages to come. Wear it with pride, ⟦25⟧!
rows.quest:8070:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8070:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8070:details:0: Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe. It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind. They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh.
rows.quest:8070:details:1: BGo forth into Zul'Gurub and witness first hand the depravity of Hakkar and the Gurubashi. Wrest the Paragons of Power that we seek from them; success will be rewarded!
rows.quest:8070:completion:0: Success! These will go a long way to building up our power against the rise of Hakkar. With your help, we've taken a significant step in ensuring that the Blood God will not destroy us all.
rows.quest:8070:completion:1: BYou've earned honor with the tribe today, ⟦26⟧. Take this - the confessor's bindings - as a symbol of our thanks.
rows.quest:8071:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8071:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8071:details:0: The confessors of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive mantle, marking them as the preservers of the tribe. These mantles are woven with powerful mojo that aids them in judging those who would threaten our tribe. As a priest, you too must spend your time judging those worthy and not; such a mantle would definitely be a blessing to you.
rows.quest:8071:details:1: BIn exchange for fighting Hakkar's minions in Zul'Gurub and bringing me the Paragons of Power I seek, I will give you a mantle worthy of our finest confessors.
rows.quest:8071:completion:0: Well done, ⟦27⟧ - the minions of Hakkar have surely felt the retribution of the Zandalar today, thanks to you. Your actions have given you a permanent place of reverence within the tribe. With our blessing, please take this confessor's mantle as your own!
rows.quest:8072:obj:0: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8072:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8072:details:0: One of Zandalar's legendary madcaps was Khar'vaxal the Cracked. Legend states that when facing the enemies of the tribe for the first time, Kar'xavan used his mantle specifically woven with "the weave of madness". His form was shrouded not only by the mantle, but also with the blinding speed of his twin daggers. Madcaps today cherish their mantle as a sign of their place in the tribe.
rows.quest:8072:details:1: BBring to me the Paragons of Power I seek, and such a mantle will be yours to weave madness unto your own enemies.
rows.quest:8072:completion:0: Victory is ours this day, thanks to the madness you have sowed upon our mutual enemies! You are to be honored amongst the Zandalar, and there is no better way of showing gratitude for your deeds than by offering you the madcap's mantle!
rows.quest:8073:obj:0: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8073:obj:1: BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8073:details:0: My eyes failed me long ago, but I do not miss them. Even in a tribe such as ours - where one's vestments convey station and purpose - the most potent of garb exudes power that simple eyes cannot see. The prized tunic of the Zandalar madcap is no exception, exuding the raw power of chaos and madness that they are able to channel.
rows.quest:8073:details:1: BThe Paragons of Power I need lie in Zul'Gurub; bring me what I seek, and I will reward you with your own legendary tunic... one befitting a weaver of madness.
rows.quest:8073:completion:0: Impressive... you have accomplished today what few thought was possible. Your reverence in the tribe is assured for a lifetime, ⟦28⟧. You have earned the right to don the madcap's tunic - do so with our blessing.
rows.quest:8074:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8074:obj:1: BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8074:details:0: Augurs know the mojo of the elements, mon. They use it as a means to guide the tribe to glory. In the dark days after the Gurubashi Empire ripped itself up, our augurs led us to our safe haven in the South Seas. They've also led us back here to the Vale, right back to the heart of evil brewin' in Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:8074:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do it and I'll give ya a belt that our augurs use - one with powerful mojo inside it!
rows.quest:8074:completion:0: I can smell the scent of vanquished evil on ya, ⟦29⟧. It's a sweet smell mon... one I think you know quite well.
rows.quest:8074:completion:1: BI know it's no small feat to have brought me the Paragons of Power required for the belt. Your deeds have not only honored the tribe, but also honored yourself amongst my tribe. Here ya are - take the augur's belt and don it as your own!
rows.quest:8075:obj:0: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8075:obj:1: BMaywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8075:details:0: The augurs of the Zandalar all wear a distinctive chest piece called a hauberk. It's fitted with the finest of silks and cloths, interwoven with strong chain. It's a symbol of not only their divinity, but also of their authority, mon. It's never wise to cross one whose life is devoted to speakin' with the spirits...
rows.quest:8075:details:1: BBring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do it and I'll give ya one of the finest hauberks our augurs would ever hope to wear!
rows.quest:8075:completion:0: I know what ya had to go through to bring me the Paragons of Power, ⟦30⟧. It wasn't easy, mon - defeatin' the evil that seeps out of Zul'Gurub like a foul ooze - but now that it is all said and done, I can easily say that you'll be revered amongst the Zandalar for ages to come!
rows.quest:8075:completion:1: BHere - take the augur's hauberk and wear it with pride!
rows.quest:8076:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8076:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8076:details:0: The demoniac seeks to embody power outright, not just possess it. More than one of our demoniacs has lost a fight with a demon; with our enemies threatening us - especially in Zul'Gurub - the power that a demoniac is able to unleash on our foes is worth the sacrifice. Our survival depends on crushing those who would destroy us; the fall of the Gurubashi Empire taught us this.
rows.quest:8076:details:1: BTravel to Zul'Gurub and gain the Paragons of Power we need. Do this, and a valuable demoniac item shall be yours.
rows.quest:8076:completion:0: Well done, ⟦31⟧. The Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub should act as a reminder of wasted power. The Gurubashi were strong at their height, but they allowed themselves to be consumed by it. A demoniac knows that the game they play is much similar, but the power unleashed is often the very thing needed for survival.
rows.quest:8076:completion:1: BUse this mantle as an honored ally of the Zandalar... it will serve you well.
rows.quest:8077:obj:0: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8077:obj:1: BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8077:details:0: The ultimate symbol of power amongst the tribe is the garb we wear in battle. A demoniac's robes have fused fine runecloth and devastatingly powerful mojo into a single fabric. The visage of the robe is said to instill fear into the minds of all who see it... especially the demons that the demoniac will eventually dominate.
rows.quest:8077:details:1: BFrom Zul'Gurub, you must bring me a very specific set of the Paragons of Power. It will be difficult... but your success will assure you of acquiring a robe for yourself.
rows.quest:8077:completion:0: Impressive - your victory in Zul'Gurub has assured us - nay, the world - that Hakkar will not prevail. The time may come when you face the Blood God directly... and should this come to pass know that your reverence is assured amongst the Zandalar tribe.
rows.quest:8077:completion:1: BOh, and this simple robe should help out too I think.
rows.quest:8078:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8078:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8078:details:0: The ultimate vengeance waits within Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must not rise again. Hakkar destroyed the Gurubashi Empire from within. No sacrifice was enough. The trolls are a shadow of former glories. I know this is because of Hakkar.
rows.quest:8078:details:1: BBecome the vindicator you were meant to be. Wreak havoc on the minions of evil. Zul'Gurub must taste Zandalar vengeance. Bring me proof in the Paragons of Power. You will receive the vindicator's belt. You will receive real power.
rows.quest:8078:completion:0: The way of the vindicator is now known to you. You have brought honor to the tribe. You have brought honor to yourself. You have brought pain to our enemies.
rows.quest:8078:completion:1: BThe vindicator's belt is yours. You are surely becoming one with the way of the vindicator.
rows.quest:8079:obj:0: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8079:obj:1: BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8079:details:0: The vindicator's symbol of power is the breastplate. It is forged with powerful mojo. It is trusted only to those we revere. It is the Zandalar symbol of vengeance.
rows.quest:8079:details:1: BTo become a vindicator is to become vengeance. Take the Paragons of Power we need from Zul'Gurub. Bring them to us. We will take the mojo stolen from us. We will make the minions of Hakkar pay. We will reward you with the vindicator's breastplate.
rows.quest:8079:completion:0: You are to be revered for your deeds. The tribe rewards its heroes. Zul'Gurub has tasted Zandalar vengeance like never before.
rows.quest:8079:completion:1: BYour deeds will herald the deeds of others to come. They will look upon you as a sign of real power. They will look upon you as vengeance personified!
rows.quest:8101:completion:0: ⟦33⟧, the pebble held within the frame of this talisman comes from Mount Kajaro in the South Seas. Mount Kajaro is an area plagued by volatility - marked by violent and oftentimes magical volcanic eruptions.
rows.quest:8101:completion:1: BAs your bond with the trolls of Zandalar grows, so too shall the power of this pebble. Harness the power of the pebble to strike down our enemies. Be like the mountain: Quick, explosive, deadly...
